Your holdings:

Watch:
Keep a close eye on further signs of weakness in the broader AI/tech sector, especially how inflation fears continue to impact growth stocks.

Bottom line:
Prioritize risk management and address your deeply underwater, leveraged positions immediately, given the shifting tech sentiment and margin exposure.
plays: SMCI is below its stop of 37.30. Consider exiting this position to manage risk and prevent further losses.
Review your leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, SPAL) given their significant losses and decay; consider trimming or exiting to reduce your high margin exposure.
